verdict.rationale: Instinct clearly handles delegated one-off tasks that run on their own and report back. A reviewer asked by iMessage, the agent made the call, and the confirmation came back in the same chat. It also proactively follows up on threads and texts or calls you, and it ran podcast-booking follow-ups while pinging the reviewer only when needed. Missing for 10: any documented way to schedule recurring tasks or set a time for a one-off task, configurable result reports or digests, and first-party docs describing the scheduling mechanism.
